name: Human Presence
description: Windows MDM settings in the Human Presence category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Force Instant Lock
properties.description: Determines whether Lock on Leave is forced on/off by the MDM policy. The user will not be able to change this setting and the toggle in the UI will be greyed out.

properties.name: Force Instant Wake
properties.description: Determines whether Wake on Arrival is forced on/off by the MDM policy. The user will not be able to change this setting and the toggle in the UI will be greyed out.

properties.name: Force Lock Timeout
properties.description: Determines the timeout for Lock on Leave forced by the MDM policy. The user will be unable to change this setting and the toggle in the UI will be greyed out.

properties.name: Force Onlooker Detection
properties.description: Determines whether detect when other people are looking at my screen is forced on/off by the MDM policy. The user will not be able to change this setting and the UI will be greyed out.

properties.name: Force Onlooker Detection Action
properties.description: Determines whether the Onlooker Detection action is forced by the MDM policy. The user will not be able to change this setting and the toggle in the UI will be greyed out.
